title: Mathad Mathadu Mallige
desc: A floriculturist and a firm believer of Gandhism, opposes the local politicians to secure his plot of land and the injustice against villagers.

title: Rajani
desc: Rajani, an unemployed software engineer, falls in love with Sandhya. However, their relationship is threatened by a gangster who stalks and harasses Sandhya.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Snehana Preethina
desc: The rich fathers of Adi and Lakshmi hatch a plot to separate them from their poor respective lovers, Sindhu and Soorya. However, Adi soon realises the truth and decides to set things right.

title: Natasaarvabhowma
desc: An investigative journalist, Gagan, moves to Bengaluru and ends up living in a supposedly haunted house. Soon, he realises a change in his behaviour after falling prey to supernatural activities.

title: Bagheera
desc: In a lawless land plagued by injustice and corruption, a police officer becomes a vigilante, protecting the innocent and punishing the guilty.
